adds.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#4
adds.text: When Magneto attacks a chemical plant, Rogue tries to steal his power, but he keeps her from getting close and disables the X-Men.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Keeps Rogue from touching him at the chemical plant.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An X-Man who tries to drain his power.
adds.evidence: Deadly Reunions (#4): Cyclops, Storm and Rogue face Magneto at the Metro Chemical factory; even Rogue, when she tries to steal some of his power, cannot get close to him, and he disarms them all. (Rogue never deals with him in Enter Magneto, #3.)

adds.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#31
adds.text: While most of the team goes to Muir Island, Storm stays behind with Cyclops to watch over Jean as she struggles with her new power.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Watches over Jean as the Phoenix grows in her.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Storm watches over after the shuttle crash.
adds.evidence: The Phoenix Saga, Part III (#31): while most of the X-Men travel to Muir Island to save Xavier from Juggernaut, Storm and Cyclops remain behind to care for Jean, who then teleports to Muir Island.

adds.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#48
adds.text: Magneto welcomes Gambit, with Xavier and Beast, aboard Asteroid M as his guest, and Gambit is later jailed by the Acolytes for Magneto's supposed murder.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A guest on Asteroid M, blamed for his supposed death.
adds.evidence: Sanctuary, Part 1 (#48): Magneto offers to let Xavier and his two escorts, Gambit and Beast, join him on Asteroid M; after Fabian Cortez ejects Magneto into space and blames the X-Men, Gambit stays behind and is imprisoned for Magneto's murder. Gambit never fights Magneto in this series.

adds.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#37
adds.text: Xavier tells Jubilee about Iceman and Lorna, who once served on his X-Men, and the X-Men find Lorna again as a member of X-Factor.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A former X-Man who joins X-Factor.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Led Lorna in the early X-Men.
adds.evidence: Cold Comfort (#37): Xavier explains Iceman's past to Jubilee, including his girlfriend Lorna Dane; the episode establishes Lorna as an early X-Man beside Iceman, and the X-Men find her in Forge's X-Factor, where she chooses to stay.

adds.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#1
adds.text: Gambit fights off a Sentinel hunting Jubilee at a mall, alongside Storm and Rogue.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Mutant-hunting robots Remy fights at a mall.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fights a Sentinel at a mall to save Jubilee.
adds.evidence: Night of the Sentinels, Part I (#1): a Sentinel breaks into the mall searching for Jubilee, and Storm, Rogue and Gambit fight it off.

adds.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#35
adds.text: Gambit fights Apocalypse with the X-Men after Archangel goes after him, and Apocalypse reveals he set them all up to be rid of them.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Sets a trap for Remy and the X-Men.
adds.evidence: Obsession (#35): Archangel hunts Apocalypse and the X-Men (Gambit featured) join the fight; Apocalypse explains he set both Archangel and the X-Men up to be rid of them, nearly kills them, and is launched into space by his ship.

adds.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#10
adds.text: Rogue exposes Apocalypse's scheme on Muir Island. At Stonehenge he moves to kill her, and she breaks his hold on Archangel by absorbing it.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Tries to kill Rogue at Stonehenge.
adds.evidence: Come the Apocalypse (#10): Rogue exposes Mystique and destroys the machine that made the Horsemen; at Stonehenge Apocalypse prepares to exterminate Rogue before the X-Men arrive, and Rogue absorbs Archangel's dark side, undoing Apocalypse's conditioning.

adds.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#10
adds.text: Made Horsemen of Apocalypse together, War and Archangel take down the French army in Paris, but once Rogue frees him, Archangel turns on the other Horsemen.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Horseman Warren turns on.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Horseman who turns on War.
adds.evidence: Come the Apocalypse (#10): Apocalypse makes Archangel and Abraham Kieros (War) Horsemen; 'War and Archangel take down the French army'; after Rogue absorbs his dark side, Archangel tells the Horsemen to stop and blasts the other Horsemen away.

adds.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#35
adds.text: When Archangel goes after Apocalypse, Cyclops and the X-Men join the fight, and Apocalypse reveals he set them all up to be rid of them.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Sets a trap for Scott and the X-Men.
adds.evidence: Obsession (#35): Cyclops is featured with Gambit, Wolverine, Beast and Rogue fighting Apocalypse after Archangel's attack; Apocalypse explains he set Archangel and the X-Men up to be rid of them, nearly kills them all, and is launched into space.

owner_calls.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
owner_calls.question: In One Man's Worth, Part 2 (#55), the Storm of an erased alternate timeline (married to Wolverine there), with Bishop, Shard and Wolverine, convinces a 2055 Forge who doesn't know them to repair his time portal. That is the only exchange; Storm is absent from Cold Comfort and the Phalanx episodes only show her captured. Does that erased-timeline meeting count as a Storm and Forge stage?
options: Add ally at X-Men: The Animated Series#55: 'Storm, with Bishop, Shard and Wolverine, convinces Forge to repair his time portal so they can save the young Xavier.'
None: alternate-timeline versions in an erased reality, so the pair first deal with each other in X-Men '97#4
owner_calls.evidence: One Man's Worth, Part II: the four travel to 2055, battle Enforcers, and convince Forge to reset the time portal; Shard is injured protecting Forge; Storm and Wolverine restore the original reality.

owner_calls.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
owner_calls.question: In The Final Decision (#13) the X-Men capture Gyrich at the Lincoln Memorial and force Master Mold's location out of him; sources list Rogue in the episode (and on the surface team later) but don't say she is in the Gyrich scene. Add a stage or none?
options: Add enemy at X-Men: The Animated Series#13: 'Rogue and the X-Men capture Gyrich and force him to reveal where Master Mold is hidden.'
None: no source puts Rogue in the scene with Gyrich
owner_calls.evidence: Gyrich is captured by the X-Men and forced to reveal the second Master Mold's location (Final Decision); Rogue's page puts this in her history but without detail.
